title: The Void Totem of Undying
description: A compact, vanilla-styled totem skin built for PvP. Max visibility, smaller particles, high-contrast blue/teal runes.
body:
# 🌌 The Void Totem of Undying A clean totem redesign featuring a winged artifact with a cosmic void center and glowing ancient runes. This pack is built for players who want a sleek, competitive edge while maintaining a vanilla-friendly style. It pairs seamlessly with modern UI setups and performance clients. --- # ⚔️ PvP & Performance Features Built to optimize screen space during intense combat: * **Compact Model:** The totem is scaled down to maximize your left-hand field of view and visibility. * **Reduced Particles:** Adjusted the activation pop particles to reduce screen clutter when triggered. ![Before and After comparison](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cd704fc2d8d8e78e0fb95ce17feddf7d24a280ee_0.webp)

⚠️ **Note:** This preview image is slightly blurry due to editing. The actual textures are full 64x resolution in-game!!🎮 [In-Game view at the Bottom Page!]

# 🔊 Recommended Setup This pack is designed as a visual companion to the **[Mr.Spd's_Better Totem Sound](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/mr.spds_-better-totem-sounds)** pack. They can be used together for a matching audio and visual setup. --- # ✨ Details & Compatibility * **Vanilla Style:** Uses custom pixel art textures designed to fit into modern Minecraft styling. * **High Contrast:** Features deep cosmic teals and bright rune blues for clear hotbar visibility. * **Lightweight:** Works across modern versions of Minecraft. Fully compatible with vanilla clients as well as Fabric, Sodium, and Iris. --- # ❓ Frequently Asked Questions * **Do I need OptiFine or Fabric/Sodium?** No. It works on completely vanilla clients, as well as optimized Fabric/Sodium setups. * **Does this work on older versions?** The pack is optimized for the latest versions of Minecraft (1.21.2 and above). Using it on version 1.21.10 or below will trigger an "incompatible pack" warning due to format changes, though the textures will still load and work perfectly fine. Note that on much older versions, high-resolution textures (64x) may require optimization mods to display correctly. *Built for players who want clean visuals and zero clutter.* --- # The In-Game View!! 👀 ![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f53957367353998abe0a1276896537012a6d99ba_0.webp)
